queries.query: Yemen cadastral map parcel Amran official land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the General Authority for Land, Survey and Urban Planning (GALSUP), an official report of its Amran branch discussing city planning and neighborhood-unit plans, and a public ArcGIS Yemen administrative-boundary service. No first-party public parcel viewer or anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found.

The material describes service/procedure workflows, not an anonymous parcel map/API response.

registryEvidence.basis: GALSUP is the first-party national land/survey/urban-planning custodian, and its official Amran-branch report records local planning and neighborhood-unit work in Amran.
registryEvidence.localCustodianScope: GALSUP branch in Amran Governorate; observed scope is planning/survey/land administration. Local parcel coverage for the WUP city point was not verified.

officialSources.observation: Official GALSUP site; current public site content identifies the authority and publishes land/survey/urban-planning activity.
Official report on the GALSUP Amran branch; discusses general plan and neighborhood-unit plans for Amran city and secondary cities.
Public ArcGIS Feature Layer named YemenAdministrativeBoundaries_CopyFeatures1; schema is administrative boundaries, not cadastral parcels.
Service guide surfaced by Arabic discovery; describes surveying, maps, and land-registration procedures and requires applicant documents/branch interaction, not public parcel geometry.
Officially hosted cadastral-registration law describing property records and maps; legal/procedural evidence only.

source.name: Yemen General Authority for Land, Survey and Urban Planning (GALSUP); public Yemen administrative-boundary ArcGIS layer

requestOutcomes.outcome: Browser discovery retrieved the official public site; no parcel viewer/API or public cadastral geometry route was exposed in the inspected page.
Official Amran branch report retrieved; planning and neighborhood-unit work described, but no parcel IDs or parcel geometry.
HTTP 200; layer metadata retrieved. Layer is administrative-boundary data with a governorate-name field, not parcel data; no cadastral fields or parcel CRS qualified.
HTTP 200; bounded attribute-only administrative response returned. No parcel identity or geometry requested/retained.
